main.description: Upgrading knot sends this once it is ready to serve *every* fostered record of a repo - at exact CIDs the foster knot was giving out at ingestion time. The signature thingy is this 3rd party requesting-knot's key over dag-cbor of the same fields using the context org.tangled.temp.handover.ack.v1, such that the foster knot can verify it against the requester's did:web doc.
